notes.title: Cloud Save support! Patch 1.0.6 is out!
notes.content:
Hey escape artists!
We’ve been tunneling through bugs and blasting through code to bring you a fresh batch of fixes and features. This update adds some long-awaited magic (and a bit of extra loading time) to your prison-breaking toolkit.
Patch Notes:
[list]
[*] [b]Cloud Save is live![/b] Your progress now floats safely in the cloud. Switch devices, reinstall the game, or survive a power outage, your tunnel stays intact. Heads up: the game might take a bit longer to load and save. That’s the cost of syncing your escape plan with the sky.
[*] [b]Item spawn rebalanced in maximum security.[/b] Early tunnel stages were a bit too brutal. We’ve tweaked item spawns so you’re not stuck digging through dirt with a wooden stick and a dream.
[*] [b] Dynamite tweaks.[/b] Blowing up rocks underground finally works as expected. No more awkward fizzles, just glorious, dusty explosions.
[*] [b]Various minor fixes and tweaks. [/b] We squashed a few sneaky bugs, smoothed out some rough edges, and gave the game a little extra polish. You might not notice them all, but your escape should feel just a bit smoother.
[/list]
Thanks for all your feedback and support. Keep digging, keep scheming, and remember: freedom is just one well-placed dynamite stick away.
If anything feels off, let us know at support@digitalmelody.eu or scream into the nearest vent. We’re listening.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.5 with optimization and performance improvements
notes.content:
Dear Runaways,

We've significantly optimized memory and resource usage to ensure the game runs smoothly and smoothly on low-end devices. This should also prevent any crashes.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.4 - High Security chapter fixes
notes.content:
Hey escape artists! We've been digging deep — not just tunnels, but into the code — to bring you a smoother, more reliable prison-breaking experience. This update tackles some pesky bugs and polishes up the gameplay.

Patch Notes:
- Fixed an issue where save loading would freeze at 100%. No more staring at that last percent!
- Resolved a bug causing loss of control over your character while crawling through tunnels.
 Addressed a problem with buying food when your respect level was sky-high. Even legends need lunch.
- Various minor fixes and stability improvements.
Thanks for all your feedback and support — keep digging, keep scheming, and remember: freedom is just one tunnel away.

If you experience any other problems, please let us know and we'll try to fix them quickly! Have fun and enjoy the soft sand!

notes.title: Maximum Security update is out!
notes.content: [p][b]The huge update you've been waiting for![/b][/p][p]A brand new chapter and a continuation of our rebellious hero's adventure.[/p][p]It's time to face new challenges in the [b]High Security Prison[/b] update![/p][p]The new mode introduces a completely new, more secure prison ward, along with:[/p][list][*][p]A much longer excavation and a challenging corridor system; without a compass, it's going to be tough[/p][/*][*][p]Boulders underground that can only be destroyed with dynamite[/p][/*][*][p]New, eccentric and charming characters[/p][/*][*][p]A guard who is sensitive to the noise of dynamite and will be more of a nuisance[/p][/*][*][p]New items and chests to find[/p][/*][*][p]A police chase and even more fun![/p][/*][*][p]Improved save system - separate save slots for each chapter[/p][/*][*][p]New achievements in the new chapter[/p][/*][*][p]Performance optimizations and minor bug fixes[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45601067/a1c6763eeded5eee8c4fc4b1029f729e30f8bf48.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: August 11th - some new features you asked for
notes.content:
[b]Hey escapees![/b]  We're back with a little appetizer before diving into work on Hardcore Mode. For now, here's what's on the menu:
[list]
[*] [b]Low End Mode:[/b] Available only in the settings from the main menu. We recommend enabling it only if digging causes noticeable lag when creating holes. Activating this mode create the "alternate tunnel", but switching back will restore the hole. Maybe someone will find an alternative use for it!
[*] [b]Inverted Y-Axis:[/b] You asked for it. Now it's here.
[*] [b]UI Scaling:[/b] Originally made for Steam Deck, but it might come in handy for others too.
[*] [b]Indicator above the teapot and coffee machine[/b] when they're ready to use.
[*] [b]Arrow key movement support:[/b] You can now control your character using the arrow keys. A little something for the left-handed players.
[*] [b]Improved item pickup near the metro tunnel.[/b]
[/list]
More fixes coming soon, but for now, we're heading back to work on Hardcore Mode!

notes.title: First big update in progress - HARDCORE MODE is coming soon!
notes.content: [p]We're working on our first major update – [b]Hardcore mode[/b], which will introduce an additional gameplay mode for those who have completed the first mission and are eager for more.[/p][p]The new mode will introduce the following additions:[/p][list][*][p]a much larger excavation site[/p][/*][*][p]a maze to dig through, where you won't find the exit without a compass[/p][/*][*][p]added boulders and stones that can only be destroyed with dynamite[/p][/*][*][p]a less predictable and more malicious guard[/p][/*][*][p]a terrifying and dynamic police chase (with aggressive police drivers)[/p][/*][*][p]brand new achievements[/p][/*][/list][p]Stay tuned, we'll keep you updated on our progress, and thanks for playing![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45601067/824844e2a1fca4b8800ad5d2579a1cb8c1200521.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Thanks for a great start! New stuff coming soon!
notes.content: [p]Thanks for sticking with us and digging! There are over [b]35,000[/b] of you already! Wow![/p][p]Some of you have already escaped prison. [b]Congratulations[/b], but don't abandon the game, because it will soon have new challenges for you. [/p][p]Several more patches will be released soon to fix the issues you reported. Thanks for reporting them; another[b] patch is out today[/b].[/p][p]But the most important news is that... we're working on the [b]first major update[/b] for Prison Escape Simulator. For now, we'll reveal that a new game mode will be coming, and you'll learn more about it soon. We'll also soon [b]reveal a roadmap[/b] of what you can expect in future updates. If you'd like to share what you'd like to see in the game, let us know.[/p][p][b]Stay tuned and thanks for playing![/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45601067/19d3b2a759a2a721060aed0ab71ba36b21938b2c.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Patch 1.0.3 is ready! Faster loading of what awaits you after finding the ladder
notes.content:
If the game was installed on a slow HDD, loading the scene that occurs after reaching the ladder in the tunnel could take a very long time. Some of you thought there was a crash or the game had frozen. We've fixed this issue, and now everyone can quickly use the ladder and continue their escape.

[b]Changelog:[/b]
The ladder no longer requires a 3-minute wait. (Ladder crash/dark void/etc.)
Game size optimization (reduced to 9.2GB!)

[b]Known Issues:[/b]
Occasionally, a bug causes the next lunch time message to appear incorrectly after going to sleep. However, the daily cycle itself doesn't change. It's just a visual glitch. We're investigating the cause of this behavior.

Information about the first major update coming soon. Stay tuned!

notes.title: Patch 1.0.2 is live! Fixing input issues and some performance improvements
notes.content:
More fixes are ready! We're working on further improvements and huge content update. Stay tuned!

[b]Changelog:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed input issue. Its should works as intended now. Even on Steamdeck with docked mode!
[*] Rarity Color was added to the underground junk
[*] Fixed bug with double "grab".
[/list]
[b]Known issue:[/b]
If you get stuck in the void after using the ladder just wait. This loading time can take 3 minutes, if you installed the game on 5400RPM HDD. Go take some tea this time. We will investigate this case to improve this. (edited)

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1 has been released!
notes.content:
First of all, thank you so much for playing and providing your valuable feedback. We've already started implementing some of the things you've been asking for, and we're starting with the first patch with minor fixes.

Finally, an important note about Steam Input. More fixes are on the way. Stay tuned!

[b]Changelog:[/b]
[list]
[*] You can now hold the button responsible for digging instead of clicking repeatedly.
[*] Improved item pickup functionality near the tunnel descent.
[*] Fixed save issues where interaction with items was impossible.
[*] Updated languages.
[*] Fixed several visual glitches.
[/list]
[b]Known issue:[/b]
Steam Input can cause keyboard input interruption. Workaround for now:  Unplug your controller/steering wheel etc or disable Steam Input in game properties.

notes.title: You can escape prison NOW! 15% off your introductory price!
notes.content: [p]We know you've been waiting for this moment for a long time. You want to dig, trade, and test your wits and resourcefulness.[/p][p]We want as many of you as possible to spend a pleasant weekend digging in the dirt and practicing lifting barbells, or maybe playing three-card games or one-armed bandits?[/p][p]That's why we're launching Prison Escape Simulator: Dig Out at a super attractive price. We want you to break your escape records and share them. Will anyone get under 3 hours? Will anyone escape without a single catch from a guard?[/p][p]Will anyone hit 10 baskets in a row?[/p][p]Will anyone win $1,000 on slots in prison?[/p][p]Have fun and unlock achievements. Let us know how you like the game and post screenshots of your cells - do you have a coffee machine and a chaise longue?[/p]

notes.title: The game launches on July 25, 2025!
notes.content: [p]In just three days, you'll have the chance to test your skills and wits in a small cell where you've been imprisoned for a rather trivial offense.[/p][p]Digging, trading, cunning, and training will give you the strength to break free. Will you manage to escape from this prison where the soup doesn't taste like home?[/p][p]If you've played the Prison Escapade Simulator: Dig Out demo, you'll know that in the full game you'll be able to:[/p][p]- Go on lunch breaks, exercise, and play with your fellow inmates[/p][p]- Buy furniture, decorate, and expand your cell to improve your stats[/p][p]- Complete daily missions for the lovable Big Jeremy[/p][p]- Use dynamite and glow sticks to illuminate the dark corridors of your excavation pit and abandoned tunnels[/p][p]- Play basketball—if you find the key to the second yard[/p][p]- Read letters from your friend, who will give you valuable tips[/p][p]- Escape—but, we're sorry, it won't be easy, and not everyone will succeed.[/p][p]The game launches this Friday, July 25, 2025, at 1:00 PM GMT[/p]

notes.title: The demo is out now!
notes.content:
Try it here:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3710390/Prison_Escape_Simulator_Dig_Out_Demo/]Prison Escape Simulator: Dig Out Demo[/url]

The Prison Escape SImulator: Dig Out demo will let you test out the basic mechanics and get a feel for the game. You won't escape from prison, but maybe you'll find friends or something valuable underground?

Play it today, let me know if you liked it. The demo will participate in the June Next Fest - a festival of demos.
